root.name: Marienbad System: Berg Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 Nf6 2. Nf3 b6 3. g3 Bb7 4. Bg2 c5 5. c4 cxd4 6. Qxd4

overview: White has traded in the centre with Qxd4 against the queenside fianchetto set-up; White fianchettoes with Bg2 and plays Nc3 and Qd3 with a small space edge, while Black plays ...Nc6, ...e6 and ...Be7 and aims for ...d5 or ...d6. It is a positional Queen’s Indian-style game.

white_ideas.idea: Develop with Nc3, Qd3 and O-O
Use the c4 pawn and centre for a small edge

black_ideas.idea: Challenge the queen with ...Nc6 and ...Bxf3 ideas

typical_structures.structure: Open d-file, fianchettos on both sides

character.notes: Neither sharp nor especially solid. Balanced.

approach.notes: Standard in the Queen’s Indian tradition.

approach.reason: Standard in the Queen’s Indian tradition.
